main_measure.name: mean unusual 18-bar move of short cases (signed for the short), pooled
main_measure.threshold: confirm: mean > 0 with t >= 2 over >= 30 cases and supporting check > 0; reject: mean < 0 with t <= -2 over >= 30 cases

supporting_check.name: mean unusual move of cases with |forecast| above median minus the others

decided_by: A confirming t (>= 2, positive mean) whose supporting check is not above 0.
reading: A case is the first short bet (forecast falling >= 2 points below its highest short level since the last bet, reset at flat or side change) in each 18-bar grid cell counted from each window's first row, the drift is the coin's mean non-overlapping 18-bar return over all its windows, and cases at the median |forecast| go to the smaller group.
